about: Notes on single clips (their sources are listed in the app's Credits). Each group gives its clips (source ids) a 'label', shown where labels.json has none, and a 'note', shown with the clip: its 'tag' also marks the clip's row, 'warn' shows it as a warning, and 'min_ms' is the shortest replacement that works.

groups.label: Void Death
groups.note: Never plays. Void missions play the regular Illuminate death music, and no playlist in the game data plays this one.

groups.label: Calm
groups.note: Plays when approaching an outpost.

groups.label: Stealth
groups.note: Plays while fighting undetected, or while enemies search.

groups.label: Battle Stinger
groups.note: Plays when enemies spot the squad and engage.

groups.label: Calm Stinger
groups.note: Plays when few enemies are left, or when leaving a fight.

groups.label: Reinforcement Stinger
groups.note: Plays on a respawn in the middle of a fight.

groups.label: Stinger Out of Nowhere
groups.note: Plays with no danger nearby, possibly when distant enemies give chase.

groups.note: Plays when few enemies are left, or when leaving a fight.

groups.label: Calm Stinger (End of Battle)
groups.note: Plays when few enemies are left, or when leaving a fight. May also play on death.

groups.note: Plays when enemies spot the squad and engage.

groups.label: Intense Battle Stinger
groups.note: Plays when enemies spot the squad and engage.

groups.label: Reinforcement Stinger
groups.note: Plays on a respawn in the middle of a fight.
Low drums under another stem, barely audible.
Make-Up Gain has no effect here, so set the loudness in the file. Keep Fit timing on, because the track has to take the new clip's length.

groups.label: Supercruise
groups.note: Plays 6 dB louder than the ship music after it, and replacements are unreliable. To skip it, use silence with Move straight on.
The hellpod launches 7.867 s into this clip. Time the new audio to match.

groups.label: Long Descent
groups.note: Likely plays when the drop outlasts the first descent clip, as on a slow connection.

groups.label: Touchdown
groups.note: The game fades this clip in over its first 0.8 s and lowers it by 30% at 1.6 s.
Its first 150 ms can be silent.
A replacement must be at least 7.5 s long.
A replacement must be at least 9 s long.
A replacement must be at least 5.5 s long.
